cards.text: King Uzziah of Judah went into the temple to burn incense, a job only for the priests, and leprosy broke out on his forehead (2 Chronicles 26:16-21). While he lived cut off, his son Jotham had charge of the palace and governed the people (2 Chronicles 26:21). Now Jotham becomes king at twenty-five, and he reigns in Jerusalem sixteen years.
So how does Jotham do? He does what's right in the eyes of the LORD, just like his father Uzziah, and that's a GOOD start, friend.

cards.question: King Jotham goes into the temple of the LORD, the way his father Uzziah did.
King Jotham does what's right in the eyes of the LORD. What about the people of Judah?

answers.text: They turn back to the LORD

cards.text: Then Jotham rebuilds the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD and works extensively on the wall at the hill of Ophel. EXTENSIVELY, friend, this man did NOT hit the snooze button.

cards.question: Jotham builds cities in the hill country of Judah, and out in the forests he builds fortresses and ___.

cards.text: Jotham isn't only a builder, friend. He also goes to war against the king of the Ammonites, a nation across the Jordan.

cards.question: King Jotham goes to war against the king of the Ammonites. How does it end?

cards.text: And that year the Ammonites give him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley. TEN THOUSAND cors of wheat, friend, and I have never seen that much flour in one place in my LIFE.

cards.question: After that first year, the Ammonites never pay King Jotham again.

cards.text: So Jotham grows powerful, and the text tells us exactly why. Lean in, friend, because this is the whole recipe right here.

answers.text: He ordered his ways before the LORD his God
He brought many offerings before the LORD his God
He made peace with all the kings around him

cards.text: The rest of what Jotham did, all his wars and his ways, is written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
Twenty-five when he became king, sixteen years in Jerusalem. Then Jotham rests with his fathers.

cards.question: King Jotham is buried in the City of ___.
After King Jotham, his son Ahaz reigns in his place.
